$description: Performance budgets (#1188), read by tools/checks/perf-budget.mjs on the built CDN files. A limit is never raised to pass: lower it in the same PR when a measure drops well below it; raising one needs a decision record with G3 (DS Architect). The total size of plenix.css is printed, never limited (owner, plenix-platform#460).

scopeTokens.why: Custom properties declared in one CSS scope that reaches elements other than :root. Each such element recomputes them for its whole subtree. 1.6.1: 5,563 on ':root, [data-plx-density], [data-plx-interaction]'. The DS Architect narrows that scope (#1188); lower this limit with it.

jsBrotli.why: plenix.js on the wire, brotli quality 5 (the web host's setting, deploy/web/plenix-compression.conf). 1.6.1: 552,947 B; nginx compresses in chunks, so the wire shows about 3% more (571,727 B live on 2026-11-10).
